kindling.title: GLM-5.3
kindling.variant: exlr8 bit225, 4-bit MLA latent KV, INT4 DFlash + 48 GB SSD KV
kindling.summary: Full GLM-5.3 (743B) on just two DGX Sparks (256 GB unified memory total) at TP=2 with upstream gr8: EXLR8 bit225 mixed-precision weights, 4-bit MLA latent KV (172K pool), native INT4 DFlash + MTP=1, and built-in 48 GB NVMe SSD KV store. Live-verified at RealMark 935.5 Grade A (16/16 all lanes, 1,001.8 at C=4, 72.9 tok/s C=4 aggregate decode, 99.2% cache hit across 307K active context), 47.0 tok/s code decode, 443/418/369 tok/s cold prefill (8K/32K/128K), 128K needle PASS, and 0.686 GiB live MemAvailable floor.
